answer: Attention Decay Windows: each identity holds a rolling window requiring a minimum of live, human-paced interactions with decay proportional to idle time; a cloned swarm must staff every clone continuously or its eligibility collapses past the window. Idle clones fall below the tundra line and lose routing priority. Sustained attention is the scarce input, so an attacker's cost scales linearly with clone count times hours, not a one-time fee. Peak eligibility requires reaching the zenith of activity, resetting after neglect. A lone raven can't fake a flock.
